title: As a founder, I can share a booking link where invitees pick a time from my live availability — no back-and-forth email
As a founder, I can offer multiple event types with their own durations, locations, custom questions, and confirmation rules
As a knowledge worker, I can protect my calendar with buffers before and after meetings, minimum notice, daily booking caps, and date-range windows
As a knowledge worker, invitees always see slots in their own time zone — detection, display, and DST handling are automatic
As a founder, I can collect payment (e.g. via Stripe) at the moment of booking for paid sessions
As a sales lead, inbound meetings distribute across my team round-robin, with weighting or priority so load stays fair
As a sales lead, I can offer collective events that only show slots when every required host is free
As a sales lead, a routing form qualifies invitees and sends them to the right person or team based on their answers
As a knowledge worker, I can connect several calendars (Google, Outlook, Apple) and every one is checked for conflicts so I never get double-booked
As a knowledge worker, busy blocks sync between my work and personal calendars automatically so all my schedules stay in step
As a knowledge worker, I can define availability schedules with working hours, date overrides, and out-of-office periods
As a knowledge worker, AI schedules my tasks into real calendar blocks around meetings and deadlines, and re-plans automatically when things change
As a knowledge worker, the product auto-defends recurring focus time and habits, flexibly moving them when conflicts appear instead of dropping them
As a knowledge worker, AI finds and continuously optimizes the best meeting time across all attendees' calendars, not just the first open slot
As a sales lead, automated reminder and follow-up sequences (email/SMS) fire around every booking to cut no-shows
As a founder, invitees can reschedule or cancel from their confirmation, with my policies enforced and calendars updated everywhere
As a founder, every booking gets a video conference link automatically (Zoom, Google Meet, Teams, or native video)
As a developer, I can embed the booking experience in my own site — inline, popup, or floating widget — with a documented snippet
As a sales lead, bookings flow into my CRM and automation stack (Salesforce, HubSpot, Zapier) without manual copying
As a developer, I can self-host the full scheduling engine from source or a container image under an open-source license
As a developer, a documented REST API lets me manage event types, availability, and bookings programmatically — enough to build scheduling into my own product
As a developer, webhooks notify my systems in real time when bookings are created, rescheduled, or canceled
As a founder, the free tier covers real individual scheduling — a usable booking link without a paid plan
As a founder, published per-seat pricing tells me exactly what each tier costs and includes before I talk to sales
As an AI-native user, my agent can check availability, book, reschedule, and cancel meetings end to end through the API or MCP — no dashboard needed
As an AI-native user, agents can use my scheduling account as a tool — an MCP server or tool-calling surface exposes availability, bookings, and event types
